snippet.title: Yotsume God - Reunion -  Steam PV
snippet.description:
SEEC's Japanese-style escape adventure, Yotsume God - Reunion - is coming to Steam!

The Steam® version is available in four languages: Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese and Korean.

◆On sale from Wednesday, February 16, 2022. 
◆Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399240/Yotsume_God_Reunion/

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

■Yotsume God - Reunion -
This is a remake of “Yotsume God”, an escape adventure novel series that was released as a game for smartphones in 2016. 
It is a Japanese-style escape adventure where Mai Sahara, a young girl who wanders into the shrine, attempts to solve 2 mysteries; the truth about Yotsume God and the Sagara family’s past.
*This title is an optimized version of the smartphone app “Yotsume God - Reunion -” with optimized operability to enable players to enjoy its content on Steam®.

■Synopsis
“An ‘unwanted child’ will be taken away by Yotsume God.”

Mai Sahara, a third-year junior high school student, goes with her father to her grandparents' house in the mountains.
Mai has idiosyncrasies that allow her to see and hear things that the people around her can't.
Before long, Mai arrives at her grandparents and falls asleep, exhausted from the journey.
As she wakes from a strange dream, two children suddenly appear in front of her.
Guided by the children, she wanders into Yotsume Shrine. 
There she meets a mysterious boy.

“Don’t touch me.”
“Misery will come upon you.”

Set in a mysterious shrine, solve 2 mysteries about the “truth” and the “past”.

The definitive version of the Japanese-style escape adventure remake "Yotsume God - Reunion -", complete with every story, is now on Steam®.


-------------------------------------------
Steam® Version Game Information
Title: Yotsume God - Reunion - 
Genre: Escape adventure novel 
Supported models: Steam® (PC game)
Release: Wednesday, February 16, 2022
Planning and scenario: SEEC

◆Official Website: https://se-ec.co.jp/appgames/yotsumegami/swst/
◆SEEC Official Twitter：https://twitter.com/SeecInc
-------------------------------------------


◆Voice Cast◆
Mai Sahara: Hiyori Kono
Imigo: Megumi Arakawa
Tagata: Kodai Sakai
Kuro: Atsuki Nakamura
Shiro: Ayaka Fujimoto
Makoto Sahara: Yu Kitada
Shuji Sagara: Kanehira Yamamoto
Others


＋＋＋＋

◆Opening Theme Song◆
"Kamikakushi"
Singer: Riko Sasaki
Lyrics: Riko Sasaki, Hisao Sasaki
Composer/Arrangement: Hisao Sasaki

＋＋＋＋


#SEEC #YotsumeGod
